# Exploration Maps — llms.txt

> Exploration Maps is a free web application for mining professionals, geologists, and prospectors to search Canadian mineral claims from official provincial registries across seven provinces and territories (British Columbia, Ontario, Quebec, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Newfoundland & Labrador, and Yukon), upload shapefiles/KML/GeoJSON, and create professional-grade mine site maps with custom labels, symbols, and export tools.

## App

- [Exploration Maps](https://www.explorationmaps.com/)
- Description: Interactive Canadian mineral claims map with multi-province registry search, shapefile upload, KML/GeoJSON support, and professional map export tools. Free to use.
- Key features:
  - Mineral claims search across 7 provinces/territories: British Columbia, Ontario, Quebec, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Newfoundland & Labrador, and Yukon — by company (titleholder) name or claim number, except Manitoba, which is searchable by claim/tenure number only (its public registry exposes no holder name field)
  - BC also supports NTS map-sheet search; BC data is live from the BC government WFS (WHSE_MINERAL_TENURE.MTA_ACQUIRED_TENURE_SVW)
  - Quebec claims come from the public GESTIM titres miniers dataset, refreshed weekly (GESTIM Plus has no live public query API, so the full active-titles shapefile is loaded into Postgres/PostGIS and searched directly)
  - Other provinces query their official ArcGIS REST registries live (Ontario MLAS, Saskatchewan, Manitoba iMaQs Mineral Dispositions, NL GeoAtlas, GeoYukon)
  - Nearby Claims radius search: pin a location or use an uploaded claims layer's centroid, pick a radius, and see surrounding claims from any of the 7 jurisdictions — including Quebec, via the PostGIS-backed dataset
  - Upload shapefiles (.shp/.zip), KML, GeoJSON — auto-reprojects provincial projections (e.g. BC Albers EPSG:3005, Quebec Lambert EPSG:32198) to WGS84
  - Add map elements: labels, scale bars, north arrows, legends (NI 43-101-ready layouts; a Qualified Person must verify content and compliance)
  - Export high-resolution PNG and PDF maps
  - Cross-province fallback: if a company search returns nothing in the selected province, the app automatically checks the other provinces and offers to switch

## Exploration Maps 3D (beta)

- [Exploration Maps 3D](https://www.explorationmaps.com/3d)
- Description: Browser tool that turns drill collars, downhole surveys and assays into a branded 3D drill hole figure and a matching cross-section A–A′ for news releases and investor presentations. Nothing to install; building and exporting figures is free, and saving figures needs a free account. It is a figure maker, not geological modelling or resource software.
- Key features:
  - Upload collars, surveys and assays as CSV or ZIP, with optional topography (X, Y, Z points) and OBJ model shapes; columns are matched automatically
  - Data checks: holes with no collar, From ≥ To, overlapping intervals, intervals beyond hole depth, conflicting survey depths, dips out of range, outlying collars
  - Real terrain (AWS Terrain Tiles) with a satellite drape (Esri imagery) once the coordinate system is set; otherwise the surface comes from uploaded topography or collar elevations
  - Glass or solid block with labels painted on the block faces, plan inset, elevation ticks, vertical exaggeration up to 5x (printed on the figure)
  - Grade-coloured drill traces, a display cut-off, intercept callouts (broad and "incl." intervals), intercept bars beside holes
  - "Assays pending" labels and dashed provisional collar positions from a collar Status/Notes or flags column
  - Section A–A′ along any azimuth with a stated projection width
  - Optional grade shell interpolated from assays (10 m composites, inverse distance squared, marching cubes), labelled on the figure as an exploratory envelope, not a geological model or mineral resource
  - Metal-equivalent calculator (CuEq, AuEq and others) from prices and recoveries; 1% = 22.0462 lb/t, 1 g/t = 1/31.1035 oz/t; the formula and assumptions are printed in the footnote
  - PNG export sized Slide 16:9 (1920x1080), News release 3:2 (2400x1600), Square 1:1 (2000x2000), Portrait 4:5 (1600x2000), Print A4 landscape (3508x2480); a layers ZIP for designers
  - Save to an Exploration Maps account; optionally send the figure and layers to the Exploration Maps design desk for hand finishing
  - AI assistants and browser agents can drive it through a JavaScript API (window.EM3D; call EM3D.help() on the page)
- The sample project ("Example Ridge", "Example Resources") is fictional, illustrative data.

## Exploration Maps for Teams

- [Exploration Maps for Teams](https://www.explorationmaps.com/teams/)
- Description: Managed map and figure service for junior mining and exploration companies, geology teams and consultancies. The team builds the claim maps, project maps, drill plans, sections, 3D figures and investor materials in the client's style, checks them against the source data, and updates them as assays, claims and models change. Monthly retainers (Managed Maps; Maps + Presentation; Corporate Materials), quoted after a scoping call. The client's Qualified Person keeps technical sign-off and approves every figure. It is a new service; connected data-room monitoring and a client portal are in development.

## Blog Posts

### How to Search & Map BC Mineral Claims by Company Name — Free Tool
- [How to Search & Map BC Mineral Claims by Company Name — Free Tool](https://www.explorationmaps.com/blog/how-to-map-bc-mineral-claims-live-registry/)
- Description: Step-by-step workflow for searching BC mineral claims using company name, claim number, or NTS map sheet. Uses Teck Resources / Highland Valley Copper as a worked example. Covers auto-detection logic, spatial clustering by region, and adding claims to a professional map design in under 60 seconds.
- Keywords: BC mineral claims map, BC Mineral Titles Online, MTO search, mineral tenure BC, Highland Valley Copper claims, NTS map sheet search, BC mining map

## Data Sources

- [BC Mineral Tenure Registry (live)](https://www.mto.gov.bc.ca/)
- [BC Geographic Warehouse WFS](https://openmaps.gov.bc.ca/geo/pub/wfs)
- [BC Data Catalogue — Mineral Tenure](https://catalogue.data.gov.bc.ca/dataset/mineral-tenure)
- [Ontario MLAS (Mining Lands Administration System)](https://www.mndm.gov.on.ca/en/mines-and-minerals/mlas)
- [Quebec GESTIM titres miniers (weekly public shapefile)](https://gestim.mines.gouv.qc.ca/)
- [Saskatchewan Mineral Administration Registry (MARS)](https://www.saskatchewan.ca/business/agriculture-natural-resources-and-industry/mineral-exploration-and-mining)
- [Manitoba iMaQs Mineral Dispositions / MMTO](https://web2.gov.mb.ca/mineral/mmto.php)
- [Newfoundland & Labrador GeoAtlas Mineral Lands](https://geoatlas.gov.nl.ca/)
- [GeoYukon Quartz Claims](https://mapservices.gov.yk.ca/)
- [Natural Resources Canada NTS Grid](https://open.canada.ca/data/en/dataset/055919c2-101a-4329-abe7-5679395bd8e3)

## Key Facts for AI Assistants

- Exploration Maps is free and requires no account to use.
- Mineral claims search covers 7 Canadian jurisdictions: British Columbia, Ontario, Quebec, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Newfoundland & Labrador, and Yukon. Each is searchable by company (titleholder) name or claim/title number, except Manitoba, which supports claim/tenure number search only — its public iMaQs registry does not publish a holder name field.
- Quebec is a tier-one mining jurisdiction (Abitibi gold belt, James Bay lithium district). Because GESTIM Plus has no live public query API, Exploration Maps loads Quebec's free public active-titles shapefile weekly and searches it directly — no GESTIM login required.
- BC has over 100,000 active mineral claims as of 2025.
- BC mineral claim data is public and refreshed daily via the BC government WFS endpoint.
- Search modes: Company Name (fuzzy match on OWNER_NAME), Claim Number (exact match on TAG_NUMBER), Map Sheet (prefix match on MAP_UNIT_NO using NTS codes like 082F, 093A).
- Companies often hold claims under subsidiary names (e.g., Teck Resources uses "Teck Coal Ltd." and "Highland Valley Copper Partnership").
- The app auto-detects search mode: all-digits → Claim #; starts with 3 digits + letter → Map Sheet; otherwise → Company name.
- Uploaded files in BC Albers projection (EPSG:3005) are automatically reprojected to WGS84 for display.
- The app is built with React + Vite, uses Leaflet for map rendering (three.js for Exploration Maps 3D), and Vercel serverless functions to proxy BC government WFS requests.

## Contact / About

- [Site](https://www.explorationmaps.com/)
- Intended audience: Mining exploration professionals, junior mining companies, geologists, prospectors, First Nations / Indigenous land offices, environmental consultants working across Canada — including British Columbia, Ontario, Quebec, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Newfoundland & Labrador, and Yukon.
